# Factions & Organizations

## Aid Society {#aid-society}

The Church Aid Society, or simply the Aid Society, is a church-affiliated organization in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) supported by local community members including [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

**Members:** [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) arrives home with the orphaned Keith twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), whose contrasting behaviors quickly manifest during dinner and bedtime. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) creates chaos throughout his first week, first by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church and later by tricking [Dora](../character/dora.md) into falling into a pigpen before attempting to pump water on her. After being sent to bed, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he also placed a toad in Marilla's bed, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) frantically removes.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

## Aids {#aids}

The Aids, also known as the [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society), is a group or organization whose esteemed members meet at local residences and attend social gatherings where they are served special tea sets.

## Americans {#americans}

The Americans are people who travel to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) during the summer season because they hold the local shore in high regard.

## Conservative {#conservative}

The Conservatives are a political party in [Canada](../codex/places.md#canada), supported by [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and opposed by Liberals such as [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

**Members:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)

## Cuthberts {#cuthberts}

The Cuthberts are a quiet and reserved family residing at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), a secluded and meticulously clean homestead situated at the edge of cleared land in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

## Debating Club {#debating-club}

[The Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Debating Club is a respectable local organization that meets fortnightly throughout the winter and hosts entertainments at the hall, such as a major paid concert featuring music, recitations, and an address by the minister to benefit the library.

## French {#french}

The French are a group whose half-grown boys are sometimes hired for farm work, though they are considered unreliable by locals due to their tendency to leave for lobster canneries or the United [States](../codex/places.md#states) once trained.

## Improvers {#improvers}

The Improvers, also known as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village Improvement Society (A.V.I.S.), is a flourishing local organization that works to beautify the community through projects such as clearing road fronts, planting flower beds, and petitioning for improvements to public and church grounds.

**Members:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), truthfulness, and the Village Improvement Society's hall project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) finishes painting the hall, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers it was accidentally painted bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. Although the society members are devastated, the incident earns them widespread sympathy from the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community.
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

## Liberal {#liberal}

The Liberal party is a political group whose members include [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), old [Martin](../character/martin.md) Bovyer, and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) Barry's father.

**Members:** [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)

## Pyes {#pyes}

The Pyes are a family whose members include Roger, Joshua, [John Andrew](../character/john-andrew.md), and Anthony, who earn a reputation for making a mess of things after bungling a paint order and painting the hall a bright blue instead of green.

## Sloanes {#sloanes}

The Sloanes are a family in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) whose members refused to deal with the Bell family after a dispute regarding their respective roles in a school concert program.
